judge.rationale: Agreement is limited: A, B, and C partially share RB/E2F, CDK, FOXM1 and proliferation-marker contributions, while A and D share CDKN1A/CDKN1B-mediated arrest, but the dominant TGF-β/SMAD, ER/MYC, and HIF1A contributors are distinct, so more than half of the complete molecular content differs and the shared-minority ceiling of 4 applies.
